Identify replication tracks from bin-level replication states

Source: R/tracks.R
define_replication_tracks.Rd

Identify contiguous segments with replication state cn (typically 4) in each cell of a bins x cells state matrix. R translation of the MATLAB functions define_replication_tracks() and list_cn_segments().

Usage

define_replication_tracks(
  genobins_matrix,
  genome_granges,
  rep_percent,
  cn = 4,
  max_na_run = 5L,
  max_na_fraction = 0.5,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

genobins_matrix

Numeric matrix of replication states (2, 4 or NA), bins x cells, with row names equal to names(genome_granges) and unique column names (e.g. compute_rep_percent()$genobins_rep_states_filtered).

genome_granges

Named GRanges, one range per row, with an is_mappable metadata column (NA counts as not mappable).

rep_percent

Named numeric vector of replicated fractions; names must include all column names of genobins_matrix (no NA).

cn

State to extract.

max_na_run

Non-negative integer; a new segment starts after more than this many consecutive NA bins.

max_na_fraction

Number in [0, 1]; maximum NA fraction of a kept segment.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam; chromosomes are processed in parallel.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default FALSE.

Value

A GRangesList named by cell; each element holds the cell's segments with metadata columns cell_id, rep_percent, cn, num_bins, flag and na_fraction.

Details

Within each chromosome and cell, bins that are NA in all cells or not mappable are treated as NA. A new segment starts at the first bin, when the state changes, at the first non-NA bin after an NA bin with no previous state in the segment, and after more than max_na_run consecutive NA bins. Trailing NA bins belong to the preceding segment. Segments whose NA fraction exceeds max_na_fraction are dropped, and only segments with state cn are returned.

The flag column (MATLAB fourth column) is 1 if a segment neighbours a segment without a state (all NA) or is adjacent to another segment with state cn.
